code: src/services/composer_library.py (identity: the front-door token + X-Composer-User-Id, the dependency of every route)

source.how: Composer's real builder (loaded by path, standard library only) writes the user_report from synthetic raw normalise reports; Director's own offline world (real router, real worker client, real template store, scripted Composer transport) uploads, stores and serves it. scripts/fixtures/template-admission-report/capture-admission-report.py regenerates these files. No network, no key, no model call, no deck text. The job rows are Director's test world (slide_count 1, a fixed clock and ids), not a real deck's.
